thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: P1 — elevated 5xx on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Customers affected: a handful of realtime sessions. Pager: @oncall-2. Please acknowledge and post initial impact estimate. :rotating_light:

sara: acked. seeing a sharp spike in error-rate at ~10:10 UTC, affecting both hosted and dedicated routes. Latency also up.

jamal: confirming, dashboards show error-rate 12% for the last 3m vs baseline 0.3%. We should check request sampling and any recent deploys.

priya: no deploys in us-west-2 in last 30m from release bot. rolling back not applicable. I'm starting timeline collection. Can oncall grab traces/logs?

oncall-2: I got the page, jumping in. what's the best query to pull streaming logs?

mike: use this ad-hoc query in logs UI — it gives request_id + status + backend node:
```sql
SELECT timestamp, request_id, status_code, backend_node, route
FROM api_request_logs
WHERE path = '/v1/generate'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

elaine: note — our log-sampler was changed yesterday for cost reasons, sampling_rate=0.05 on api_request_logs in prod. that might hide some patterns.

jamal: hmm that could explain missing KV cache logs I was expecting. can dev-log-bot confirm sampling changes and the exact timestamp?

dev-log-bot: config-change detected: `log-sampler` updated by ops-user at 2026-03-15T09:58:12Z. previous_sampling_rate=0.20 new_sampling_rate=0.05. change_id=chg_88c7.

priya: that's 12m before the spike. interesting. if sampling dropped we have less visibility just when traffic rose. need to collect what we can and request higher retention / on-demand sample increase.

oncall-2: running the query now, few results only. missing many expected request_ids. any chance there's a second logging pipeline (streaming logs) that also had changes?

ops-bot: alert: streaming-logs-ingest consumer had intermittent backlog around 2026-03-15T10:09:30Z - 10:12:15Z; consumer-lag peaked at ~2m.

mike: combine that with sampling drop and we have a blind spot. we should mark timeline: 09:58 update sampling->0.05; 10:09 streaming consumer lag. spike at ~10:10 5xx.

elaine: i'm kicking a targeted sampling override for the next 30m for path `/v1/generate` at high rate (0.8) so we capture post-mitigation telemetry. doing now.

dev-log-bot: sampling-override created by elaine at 2026-03-15T10:14:22Z; target_path=/v1/generate; override_rate=0.80; expires=30m.

sara: customer impact check — I can see two enterprise customers reported elevated 5xxs via support. their sessions mostly hit dedicated nodes. collecting request_ids to correlate.

jamal: hypothesis 1: backpressure in streaming ingest + lower sampling created a gap and surfaced latent 5xxs from a model variant. hypothesis 2: a downstream caching layer (KV store) returning 500-ish under load. need logs from kv-proxy and model-serving.

oncall-2: can someone fetch kv-proxy logs for 10:08-10:16 window? my fetch returned only partial logs.

mike: grabbing them now from instance pool 7. note: instance pool has 3 nodes rotated at 10:11 — there might be log rotation at that time.

ops-bot: runbook reminder: when logs are sampled or missing, run the ad-hoc re-ingest and sampling-override steps, tag all correlated request_ids and attach to the incident.

priya: I'm building the in-thread timeline (will paste below). also please paste any request_ids you find; we'll pin and annotate.

jamal: found one correlated request_id: r-0b9f2a (status=502) from host model-serve-12. attaching snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:10:43Z] request_id=r-0b9f2a status=502 backend_error=ModelRuntimeOOM node=model-serve-12
Stack: alloc failed, requested 2.4G
```

elaine: that suggests model OOM for that variant. does the routing policy send fallback to smaller variant? we should check smart-routing logs.

dev-log-bot: routing-policy-change: none in last 24h. Fallback policy active: canary->stable.

oncall-2: mitigation: enable immediate fallback to stable model variant for us-west-2 traffic and scale up model-serve pool by +2 nodes. executing now.

ops-bot: action executed: fallback enabled at 2026-03-15T10:17:03Z; scale request submitted for model-serve pool (delta +2).

sara: after fallback enabled error-rate dropped to ~1.2% in 4m. customer reports diminishing errors. marking mitigation effective so far.

priya: we still need to document observability gaps: 1) sampling reduction at 09:58 removed pre-spike visibility, 2) streaming ingest lag hid some events during peak, 3) log rotation on instance pool introduced partial gaps. we'll add those to RCA notes.

jamal: for RCA action items: (A) revert global sampling change or make it workload-aware; (B) increase monitoring/alert for consumer-lag; (C) ensure log rotation doesn't drop windows (streaming re-ingest test).

mike: creating follow-up ticket INS-2026-73 for action items and owner assignment.

oncall-2: handing off to next oncall @jamal for deep-dive and post-incident RCA. I'll stay on the thread for 15m overlap.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. severity lowered to P2. Please file RCA and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
